Self-hosted third-party files (unmodified except where noted). Served from this site so iPhone Safari does not need
cross-origin ES-module imports from a CDN.

ort.wasm.min.js, ort-wasm-simd.wasm, ort-wasm.wasm
  onnxruntime-web 1.18.0 — MIT License — https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
  (from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web@1.18.0/dist/)

piper-phonemize.js  (re-bundled with esbuild to a classic script, global PiperPhonemize, target safari13)
piper_phonemize.wasm, piper_phonemize.data
  @diffusionstudio/vits-web 1.0.3 / @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm 1.0.0 — https://github.com/diffusionstudio/vits-web
  contains piper-phonemize (https://github.com/rhasspy/piper-phonemize) and espeak-ng data
  (GPL-3.0 — source: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng)

vosk.js
  vosk-browser 0.0.8 (Vosk / Kaldi compiled to WebAssembly, worker inlined) — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser

vosk-model-small-fa.tar.gz
  vosk-model-small-fa-0.42 (Persian) — Apache-2.0 — https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
  repacked from the official .zip into .tar.gz (files unchanged; test/ and README removed)

tesseract.min.js
  tesseract.js 6.0.1 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js

pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs
  pdf.js — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Persian voice weights (downloaded at runtime, not stored here): rhasspy/piper-voices fa_IR-amir-medium (Hugging Face).

--- added in 1.9.0 ---
spk-campplus.onnx      3D-Speaker CAM++ speaker-embedding model (zh-en common, 200k speakers) — Apache-2.0 — modelscope/3D-Speaker (ONNX export via sherpa-onnx)
u2netp.onnx            U²-Net-p salient-object segmentation (background removal) — Apache-2.0 — github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net (ONNX as distributed by rembg)
fonts/Cairo.ttf        Cairo variable font — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — Google Fonts / github.com/Gue3bara/Cairo
seflash/logo.png       Seflash shop logo (owner's own asset, scaled copy of sami-ads/assets/logo_original.png)
tjs/transformers.min.js, tjs/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.{mjs,wasm}
                       @huggingface/transformers 3.7.5 (Apache-2.0) + bundled onnxruntime-web 1.22.0-dev (MIT) — npm
